label: Half-court zone model
definition: A 17-cell decomposition of the offensive half court plus two aggregate areas. Coordinates use feet on a 50ft x 47ft half court: x = 0 at the LEFT sideline (as seen from the baseline looking up court), y = 0 at the baseline, y increasing towards half court. Rim centre = (25.0, 5.25). Values are teaching approximations, not survey data.

coordinates.system: half-court cartesian, feet, origin at baseline/left-sideline corner

nodes.label: Frontcourt
nodes.definition: The offensive half of the court, from the baseline to the half-court line.

nodes.label: Backcourt
nodes.definition: The defensive half of the court; the ball must cross the half-court line within 8 seconds.

nodes.label: Restricted Area (Rim)
nodes.definition: The 4ft arc under the basket. A defender inside it cannot draw an offensive charge; it is also the finishing target of every roll, cut and drive.

nodes.label: Paint (Lane)
nodes.definition: The 16ft-wide lane from the baseline to the free-throw line. Home of the roll man, the offensive three-second rule and help-side defence.

nodes.label: Left Low Post (Block)
nodes.definition: The left block area beside the lane, the classic post-up and duck-in spot.

nodes.label: Right Low Post (Block)
nodes.definition: The right block area beside the lane, the classic post-up and duck-in spot.

nodes.label: Left Short Corner
nodes.definition: Baseline area between the block and the corner three, ~14-16ft from the rim. The dead spot of most zone defences and the bail-out against hard traps.

nodes.label: Right Short Corner
nodes.definition: Baseline area between the block and the corner three, ~14-16ft from the rim. The dead spot of most zone defences and the bail-out against hard traps.

nodes.label: Left Elbow
nodes.definition: The intersection of the free-throw line and the left lane line extended; the hub spot of Horns, the high-post split and the short-roll catch.

nodes.label: Right Elbow
nodes.definition: The intersection of the free-throw line and the right lane line extended; the hub spot of Horns, the high-post split and the short-roll catch.

nodes.label: High Post (Free-Throw Line)
nodes.definition: The free-throw line area, often called 'the hole' of a 2-3 zone or 'the middle'. Catching here splits a zone and forces the bottom defenders to choose.

nodes.label: Left Wing (Mid-Range)
nodes.definition: Left side of the floor above the short corner and outside the elbow; the ball-side entry against a zone and the landing spot after a screen.

nodes.label: Right Wing (Mid-Range)
nodes.definition: Right side of the floor above the short corner and outside the elbow; the ball-side entry against a zone and the landing spot after a screen.

nodes.label: Left Corner Three
nodes.definition: The shortest three on the floor (22ft). The highest-value shot in the modern game and the natural bail-out against help, traps and zone rotations.

nodes.label: Right Corner Three
nodes.definition: The shortest three on the floor (22ft). The highest-value shot in the modern game and the natural bail-out against help, traps and zone rotations.

nodes.label: Left Wing Three (Above the Break)
nodes.definition: Above-the-break three on the left wing; the relocation spot after a drive-and-kick and the primary skip-pass target.

nodes.label: Right Wing Three (Above the Break)
nodes.definition: Above-the-break three on the right wing; the relocation spot after a drive-and-kick and the primary skip-pass target.

nodes.label: Top of Key Three
nodes.definition: Above-the-break three at the top of the floor; the launch point of most ball screens, hand-offs and pull-ups.

nodes.label: Paint
nodes.definition: Inside the 16ft lane, including the restricted area.

nodes.label: Post
nodes.definition: Block and low-block areas used for post-ups and duck-ins.

nodes.label: Mid-Range
nodes.definition: Inside the arc, outside the lane: elbows, short corners, wings, high post.

nodes.label: Three-Point
nodes.definition: Beyond the 23ft 9in arc (22ft in the corners).

nodes.label: Backcourt
nodes.definition: Behind the half-court line.
